name: Upsell / Downsell Bought-or-Declined Branch

source.spec: launch-automations.spec.md section 3.3 — 'Upsell / downsell branch | Bought / declined → matching follow-up | new, small'
source.checklist: A1 (family present, template = new, small), A2 (purchase stops promotional emails/texts; everything draft_only)

purpose: One small branch per offer option page. When a contact reaches an upsell or downsell page, wait for the verified purchase event, then send exactly one matching follow-up: bought → the upsell follow-up that moves the buyer to the next offer; declined (explicit No-thanks or no verified purchase by the wait deadline) → the downsell follow-up for that downsell page. Never both. Everything is built as a draft and never sends to a real contact.

applies_to.one_workflow_per: option page (one per upsell page and one per downsell page)

trigger.what_starts_it: Contact reaches an offer option page, or explicitly declines that option.
trigger.ghl_trigger_type: Tag Added = `option-branch:<slot>:<offer_id>` (set by the option page view; the No-thanks link also adds `declined-<offer_id>` before this tag so the first IF/ELSE can skip the wait).
entry_conditions: Contact is not already tagged `bought-<slot>` or `declined-<slot>` for this option (re-entry guard)
trigger.branch_authority: The verified purchase tag `purchased-<offer_id>` written by the Skill 44 receiver/processor after a `purchase_observed` event with payment_status=succeeded. A raw page click or return URL never counts as a purchase.

bought.follow_up: Skill 50 sequence kind `upsell_followup` for this upsell page — moves the buyer to the next offer

declined.condition: Tag `declined-<offer_id>` present, or no `purchased-<offer_id>` tag after the wait deadline
declined.follow_up: Skill 50 sequence kind `downsell_followup` for this option's downsell page — the smaller option

branch.exclusivity: One branch only. The bought branch removes `declined-<offer_id>`; the declined branch never fires when `purchased-<offer_id>` is present.

sequence.action: Wait — 15 minutes (purchase webhook and processor settle window).

sequence.false: Go to step 6 (declined branch — timeout is a soft decline).

sequence.action: Enroll in the matching Skill 50 `upsell_followup` sequence (draft). End workflow.
Enroll in the matching Skill 50 `downsell_followup` sequence (draft). End workflow.

suppression.rule: A verified purchase makes the contact a buyer: stop promotional launch emails and texts for that buyer (checklist A2). The branch keeps sending only the matching offer follow-up.
suppression.authority: Skill 44's purchase processor and store re-check active entitlement state at dispatch time (A21); this workflow does not duplicate that check and never sends a promotional broadcast itself.

ghl_build.engine: Skill 44 engine (U-GHL-PROBE verdict: the official API cannot create, update, publish or trigger a workflow; it only reads them).
actions_in_order: 1. If/Else — `declined-<offer_id>` present? TRUE -> step 6; FALSE -> step 2
3. If/Else — `purchased-<offer_id>` present? TRUE -> step 4; FALSE -> step 6

launch_plan.waits_for_note: Example unit ids at template level. Each per-page instance resolves them to that page's real email-sequence and page unit ids from the launch plan.

acceptance.A1: Family `upsell_downsell` exists as a template with template = 'new' (spec calls it 'new, small'); failed_payment is not part of this family.
acceptance.A2: Every action is draft_only; the bought/declined branch never sends a promotional launch email or text, and a verified purchase suppresses them.
